Name: Homestuck Clothing for Fashion Sense
Author: timaeusDemiurge
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS]our partners and us have been playin' heavily modded stardew and found ourselves disappointed with how few homestuck mods are out there. so as the only person in the polycule who both owns aseprite AND knows a bit about how to mod the game we decided to take action.
work in progress, we wanna add as much as we can. doin' this in our free time when we're feelin' creative but not up to drawin'.[/font]
[b][font=Times New Roman]
[/font][/b][size=4][b][font=Times New Roman]1.1.0 update oh boy. sollux fictive moment. sollux glasses and eyes added, mage of doom top added, and shadin' on the first two shirts was tweaked again.[/font][/b]
[/size]
[size=6][font=Times New Roman]Current Clothing (as of 1.1.0)[/font][/size][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][size=3]Green Ghost shirt (Basic June/John Egbert shirt)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman][size=3]Orchid Horror shirt (Basic Rose Lalonde shirt)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman][size=3]Mage of Doom top[/size][/font]
[/list]
[size=6][font=Times New Roman]Current Accessories (as of 1.1.0)
[/font][/size][list]
[*]Sollux eyes
[*]Sollux glasses
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]plans for this mod include:[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]other kid/cherub shirts[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]glasses (Dave's and Dirk's are the first examples to come to mind)[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]more accessories! (had an idea for different floating fetch modi and strife cards)[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]god tier outfits [/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]alternate outfits like jade's dresses[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]possibly, recolorable versions of other shirts in the pack[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]recolorable sollux-style eyes (with layers to customize both eyes)[/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]

[/font][font=Trebuchet MS]if you have any suggestions/requests just let us know :)

somewhat inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31712]the troll shirt mod[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/223265706]aclumpofmoss413[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5205]the troll horns mod[/url]﻿ by[/font][font=Times New Roman][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56684802]seiryunohoushi[/url][/size].[/font][font=Trebuchet MS] unfortunately the troll horns mod doesn't work properly in its current state for stardew valley 1.6 but we plan on trying our hand at the horns ourselves if the creator doesn't respond to our offer to convert it to fashion sense. for the time being though, we have a comment on the troll horns mod page detailing how to make it work in 1.6.

[url=https://homestuck.net/homestuck.html]click here to read homestuck[/url][/font]
